text.tspan: Where a real item ends up physically unreachable
Built on the Pi, NEVER commanded by the server
What every bay physically has — config.py, kiosk_config.json
NO door reopened — the owner's item is
sealed in a bay the database calls empty
NO door reopened — same, with a disputed item
bay set OCCUPIED. The owner scans and
No owner-retrieval flow exists at all
The nightly cron only looks at ACTIVE past endDate.
Late COLLECTION is not modelled anywhere
and Node only ever sends main_door
The only physical recovery that exists:
It CAN send drop_item, bottom_door and the actuator —
but it is a raw hardware command, rental-unaware,
and there is no UI for it
